name: Nakahara Nozomi
source:
Nozomi is a member of Kanamin Kitchen. Nozomi appears to be a polite and friendly person. [url=/c46554]Rise[/url] stated that her real self is a pretty shy and docile person and the type who gets all flustered and nervous when she has to talk about herself.

To her fans, Nozomi is the confident, uninhibited "Prince Nozomi" who is very self-assured. Nozomi's insecurity is her social anxiety; she is bad at talking to people and doesn't want to hurt people's feelings if they see her as her true self.

[From [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Nozomi_Nakahara]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
